name: phi_otdr_open_world_confirmatory_v1

features.fit: StandardScaler fit on training windows from the five seen classes only

encoder.outer_holdout_access: held-out class excluded from encoder and scaler fitting

pre_enrollment.gallery: training-session embeddings from the five seen classes
pre_enrollment.threshold: 5th percentile of known calibration-session confidence (target 95% known acceptance)

post_enrollment.gallery: training sessions plus held-out-class support sessions
post_enrollment.score: negative mean Euclidean distance to the three nearest sessions in each class

control: same session-level 3-NN Euclidean lifecycle on standardized full features without the learned encoder
final_query_policy: final_query is used once by this locked evaluator and never for fitting, selection, calibration, or support choice
uncertainty: three encoder seeds; 20 deterministic support draws; class-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals
